|errata_history=This is a pre-release (playtest) image of [[A Cunning Warrior]] (version 1 of 3): the PC published it before Virtual Set 24 was officially released (30 December 2024), so it is not the original (Bill, 12 November 2026: pre-release images are Playtest versions; only the image at official release is the original). The current text is [[A Cunning Warrior (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
